title: Gateway TOFU pins keys without authenticated proof of possession
description: Security review P1. New TrustStore::verify_tofu in rust/lichen-gateway/src/trust.rs accepts only public key plus claimed IID, verifies deterministic derivation, and immediately returns PinAndAccept/inserts the key. It does not verify a Schnorr signature, OSCORE identity, challenge, or owner-issued authenticated-message capability. An unauthenticated first-contact key claim can pre-pin a gateway identity and block the legitimate key; callers are merely expected to sequence separate helpers correctly. Require proof of possession and message/domain/freshness verification in the atomic pin operation, or accept an opaque verified gateway identity capability; add tests that a derived IID/public key without a valid signed exchange cannot create a pin.
